response.text:
I can’t access or modify your public status page from here. I can, however, produce a ready-to-paste postmortem in the format you need.

Please either:
- Paste the approved incident writeup here, or
- Confirm you want me to convert your internal incident details into a postmortem and tell me the desired output format (Markdown, HTML, or plain text) and any required metadata fields (incident ID, start/end times, severity, contact).

Once you provide the writeup or confirm details/format, I’ll return the final postmortem text formatted and ready to publish.
